notes: Posted 25 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Start - 9': the objective, Death Star, Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Start Your Engines!, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and Watto's Box; these count toward the 60. The post adds: if the opponent starts with a racer, play Bad Feeling Have I.

Posted objective 'Set Your Course For Alderaan/The Backside Doesn't Matter' (joke back-side name) dested Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe; the deck runs Alderaan and the Death Star sites.

Joke names as posted: 'Mara Jade's Vibrator' dested Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Maul's Glowstick' dested Maul's Lightsaber (Tatooine); 'Smooth Dr. Easy and Ponda Baba' dested Dr. Evazan & •Ponda Baba; 'Gramma Tarkin' dested Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Prince Xixor' dested Prince Xizor; 'Twi'Lek' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Barrier' dested Imperial Barrier.

Two-sided generic cards dested the Dark pages: Alderaan (Dark), Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark), Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark), Tatooine: Podrace Arena (Dark), Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark), Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark). 'Darth Maul' dested the Tatooine Darth Maul. Secret Plans and Come Here You Big Coward are 2001 Effects, counted in the 60.

The strategy says the poster went 2–1 with the deck at the Mirkwood team tournament (wins by 33 and 35, a loss by about 15); his team placed 11th of 12. He also names grabber, SSPFT and decree as cards he should add (not in the list).
